blockers.problem: The first-time wizard steps are presented unconditionally even though the Dossier limits them to projects where Google Auth platform is not configured.
blockers.suggestion: Place steps 3–13 under the unconfigured-project condition and direct already-configured projects straight to Data Access.

blockers.problem: The guide omits the Dossier's instruction that Authorized JavaScript origins is not needed for this flow.
blockers.suggestion: Tell the reader to leave Authorized JavaScript origins empty.

blockers.problem: The transcluded Manual OAuth flow omits the canonical fact that the Redirect URI has a copy button.
blockers.suggestion: Restore the Redirect URI copy-button fact from doctrine/speakeasy-setup.md.

blockers.problem: The final sentence does not faithfully render the canonical closing pointer recorded in the Dossier.
blockers.suggestion: Use the Dossier's exact setup-only closing sentence and retain the Google documentation link.

blockers.problem: The guide directs readers to choose Internal whenever available without checking whether every connecting account belongs to the Google Cloud organization, so outside accounts can be blocked from authorization.
blockers.suggestion: Direct readers to choose Internal only when every connecting account belongs to the organization; otherwise choose External and follow the test-user steps when applicable.

blockers.where: #copy-oauth-credentials, "If you miss the one-time secret, delete it and create a new one"
blockers.problem: The immediate recovery path does not identify what must be deleted or the browser controls needed to replace the missed one-time secret.
blockers.suggestion: Research and record the exact Google Auth platform navigation and control labels for deleting the affected credential and recreating it, then render that recovery path in external.md.
